lore.common: Copies the microwave beep so perfectly that the family keeps opening an empty microwave.
lore.uncommon: Learns every word you say, especially the ones you didn't mean to say in front of guests.
lore.rare: Imitates the doorbell, the phone and the kettle at the same time. The family now just stands in the hallway.
lore.epic: Phoned for a pizza in its owner's voice and ordered forty with extra peanuts.
lore.legendary: Learned every language in the city by listening at the bus stop, then got a job as the airport's announcer.

lore.common: Looks very serious and important, then steals a fish from a smaller bird.
lore.uncommon: Soars so high on warm air that it can nap while flying.
lore.rare: Snatched a salmon out of the river while a whole bear was still aiming for it.
lore.epic: Built a nest so enormous on top of a cliff that hikers mistake it for a hut.
lore.legendary: Soared so high over the canyon that it saw tomorrow's weather and warned the farmers.

names.legendary: Melitta, Bane of the Busy Bee

lore.common: Catches a bee, bashes it on a branch, then expects applause for its table manners.
lore.uncommon: Its feathers are so colourful that the flowers think it is showing off.
lore.rare: Can catch a bee mid-air from the far side of the meadow, then catch its friend on the way back.
lore.epic: Raided every beehive in the valley in one afternoon. The beekeepers now wear bird costumes to scare it.
lore.legendary: Ate so many bees in one summer that every flower in the valley had to start pollinating itself.

names.legendary: Robin Featherbright, Song of the Street

lore.common: Steals a chip right out of your hand at the seaside, then looks hurt when you shout.
lore.uncommon: Taps on the window every morning to tell you the bird feeder is empty.
lore.rare: Starts the dawn chorus at four in the morning, and expects the whole street to join in.
lore.epic: Led every pigeon in the city to the same park bench. The statue has never been so busy.
lore.legendary: Sang so beautifully at dawn that the whole neighbourhood started waking up happy. The alarm-clock makers are out of business.

names.legendary: Lord Lyre, Dancer of the Moor

lore.common: Struts round the field at dawn fluffing its tail and expects everyone to watch.
lore.uncommon: Makes a bubbling cooing sound like a kettle that won't boil.
lore.rare: Dances so hard at the morning meeting that the other grouse forget why they came.
lore.epic: Held a dance-off on the moor that lasted until lunch. The sheep joined in.
lore.legendary: Won every dance contest on the moor for so many years that the hills are named after its moves.

names.legendary: Bramble, Leader of a Million Wings

lore.common: Arrives at the bird feeder with ten friends and empties it in a minute.
lore.uncommon: Its orange chest glows like a tiny bonfire in the winter snow.
lore.rare: Finds every beech nut in the forest and leaves the squirrels nothing.
lore.epic: Arrived with a flock so huge that the whole sky went dark for an afternoon. Street lights came on.
lore.legendary: Led a winter flock of millions to the perfect beech forest. The forest is still recovering from the party.

lore.common: Sings loudly and cheerfully outside your window at sunrise, every single day.
lore.uncommon: Picks the ripest fruit off the tree the morning before you were going to pick it.
lore.rare: Its song is so catchy that the whole street is humming it by lunchtime.
lore.epic: Started a choir of bulbuls in the town square that drowned out the church bells.
lore.legendary: Sang so joyfully at the city festival that the orchestra put down its instruments and just listened.

names.legendary: Old Coucal, Drum of the Marsh

lore.common: Walks everywhere because it can't be bothered to fly, then complains about its feet.
lore.uncommon: Makes a deep hooting coop-coop sound like water glugging out of a bottle.
lore.rare: Its booming call is so deep that people check the plumbing.
lore.epic: Hooted across the marsh until every frog in the swamp lost its rhythm.
lore.legendary: Became the official drum of the marsh band, and the frogs keep time with it every night.

names.legendary: Queen Hornbilla of the Sealed Tree

lore.common: Its huge beak gets stuck in the bird feeder every single time.
lore.uncommon: Seals itself inside a hollow tree with mud and has its food delivered through a slot.
lore.rare: Its wings whoosh so loudly when it flies that it sounds like a passing train.
lore.epic: Flew over the forest with such loud wings that every monkey ducked.
lore.legendary: Sealed itself inside the grandest tree in the forest and ran the whole jungle from there by post.

lore.common: Is so blue that people think someone painted it, and keep trying to wash it.
lore.uncommon: Finds its way home by looking at the stars, then lands in the same tree every year.
lore.rare: Glows so brightly blue in the sunshine that the sky looks dull next to it.
lore.epic: Led a flock across the continent at night by the stars without a single wrong turn.
lore.legendary: Is so perfectly blue that the paint makers tried to copy it for years and gave up.

lore.common: Snaps at every butterfly it sees, then lets the boring ones go.
lore.uncommon: Its feathers shine like metal in the sun. It checks its reflection in every puddle.
lore.rare: Can catch a butterfly in mid-air without crumpling a single wing.
lore.epic: Flashed through the jungle so fast that every butterfly in the forest hid in a flower.
lore.legendary: Caught the fastest butterfly in the world after a chase that lasted a whole afternoon. Then let it go to be fair.

lore.common: Hops around under the bird feeder picking up what the other birds dropped. It says it's helping.
lore.uncommon: Flashes the white feathers on the sides of its tail whenever it flies away, like a little signal.
lore.rare: Arrives exactly when the first snow falls, every year, as if it booked the date.
lore.epic: Led a flock of snowbirds so big into a car park that every car looked like it had a hat.
lore.legendary: Became the official sign of winter: when it arrives, the whole town gets out its scarves.

lore.common: Screeches so loudly at the bird feeder that the neighbours think there's a car alarm.
lore.uncommon: Licks nectar out of flowers with a tongue like a little paintbrush.
lore.rare: Flew into the café and drank every glass of juice in one go. The staff is still cleaning.
lore.epic: Arrived in the park with a flock so loud and colourful that the fireworks display was cancelled.
lore.legendary: Turned a grey city rainbow-coloured by perching on every rooftop at once. The tourists came for a month.

names.legendary: Lady Partridge of the Pear Tree

lore.common: Sits in a pear tree every December and waits for someone to sing about it.
lore.uncommon: Scurries along the ground with its whole family in a line, like a small train.
lore.rare: Bursts out of the hedge so suddenly that walkers drop their sandwiches.
lore.epic: Burst out of a hedge with a hundred cousins and caused a traffic jam of startled cyclists.
lore.legendary: Became the star of the most famous Christmas song in history and has refused to leave the pear tree since.

lore.common: Puffs up two orange balloons on its neck every morning and booms like a bassoon.
lore.uncommon: Stamps its feet in a dance so fast that it looks like it's running on the spot.
lore.rare: Booms so loudly at sunrise that farmers miles away set their clocks by it.
lore.epic: Held a dance-off on the prairie so loud that the cows started tapping their hooves.
lore.legendary: Danced so magnificently that every bird on the prairie came to watch, including two very jealous peacocks.

lore.common: Turns white in winter and then gets lost in the snow on its way home.
lore.uncommon: Has feathery feet like slippers, so it walks on snow while everyone else sinks.
lore.rare: Changes colour with the seasons so well that it hides in the mountains all year round.
lore.epic: Hid in the snow so perfectly that a whole team of mountaineers walked over it.
lore.legendary: Blended into the snow so well that it watched every ski race at the winter games from the finish line.

lore.common: Beats its wings so loudly on a log that people think there's a motorbike in the woods.
lore.uncommon: Puffs out a ruff of feathers round its neck like a fancy collar.
lore.rare: Exploded out of the leaves so suddenly that a hiker dropped their map into the river.
lore.epic: Drummed so loudly on a fallen log that every rabbit in the forest started dancing.
lore.legendary: Played a drum solo on a log that lasted so long that the forest held a festival in its honour.

names.legendary: Lady Sulphura, Bin Queen of the Suburbs

lore.common: Screeches at sunrise so loudly that the whole street wakes up at once.
lore.uncommon: Raises its yellow crest when it's excited, which is whenever it sees a bin.
lore.rare: Learned to lift the lid of every wheelie bin in the street and taught all its friends.
lore.epic: Led a gang of cockatoos to open every bin in the suburb in one morning. The rubbish trucks just watch now.
lore.legendary: Taught every cockatoo in the country to open bins. The government has started designing bird-proof lids.

lore.common: Bobs up and down on a rock in the stream like it's listening to music.
lore.uncommon: Walks straight into the river and keeps going underwater, looking for snacks.
lore.rare: Can walk along the bottom of a rushing stream without being swept away.
lore.epic: Walked up the whole waterfall from the bottom to the top, underwater, to find the best insects.
lore.legendary: Walked the entire length of the river underwater in one day. The fish waved as it passed.

names.legendary: Henrietta, the Hen Who Ruled the Roost

lore.common: Lays an egg and then tells the whole farm about it for twenty minutes.
lore.uncommon: Crosses the road just to see if anyone is going to ask why.
lore.rare: Crows at dawn, noon, teatime and midnight, just to make sure everyone is awake.
lore.epic: Started a pecking order argument that spread to every farm in the valley.
lore.legendary: Laid a golden egg, a silver egg and a chocolate egg in the same week, then demanded a pay rise.

lore.common: Is so tiny that it gets lost in a teaspoon of sea water.
lore.uncommon: Glows softly in the dark sea, so the fish think it's a tiny night light.
lore.rare: Swims in a swarm so thick that the sea turns pink.
lore.epic: Formed a swarm so huge that a whale opened its mouth and gave up because it couldn't decide where to start.
lore.legendary: Gathered every krill in the ocean into one swarm big enough to be seen from a satellite. Then everyone went home.

lore.common: Turns bright pink in hot water and then sulks about it.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its tail and shoots backwards whenever someone looks at it.
lore.rare: Cleans fish in the rockpool and charges them in tiny shells.
lore.epic: Shot backwards so fast through the rockpool that every crab in it got its claws tangled.
lore.legendary: Escaped from every net in the harbour by swimming backwards, and now runs a rockpool cleaning business.

lore.common: Stands on one leg for hours, then falls over when it tries to switch.
lore.uncommon: Dances with its wings outstretched every time it meets a friend at the pond.
lore.rare: Inspired a thousand paper cranes and now insists on folding its own.
lore.epic: Led a dance of a thousand cranes across the wetland that made every frog stop and clap.
lore.legendary: Flew around the world with its flock and was folded into paper by every school it passed over.

names.legendary: Commander Coot of the Duck Pond

lore.common: Runs across the pond splashing loudly instead of flying, like a very wet sprinter.
lore.uncommon: Has funny lobed toes instead of webbed feet and shows them off to the ducks.
lore.rare: Bosses every duck on the pond into a different corner, then sits in the middle.
lore.epic: Splashed across the lake so much that the boats thought a storm had arrived.
lore.legendary: Took charge of every pond in the park and made the ducks queue for bread in order of size.

lore.common: Stands perfectly still in the pond for so long that people think it's a garden ornament.
lore.uncommon: Grows beautiful white plumes and preens them in front of every puddle.
lore.rare: Strikes a fish so fast that the fish doesn't notice until it's out of the water.
lore.epic: Stood so still in the marsh that a whole family of frogs built a house on its foot.
lore.legendary: Became the symbol of the marshes after standing perfectly still through a hurricane without ruffling a feather.

lore.common: Points its beak at the sky and sways with the reeds, hoping you'll mistake it for a reed.
lore.uncommon: Booms like a foghorn across the marsh so the ships think there's a lighthouse.
lore.rare: Hid in the reeds so well that the birdwatchers walked past it a dozen times.
lore.epic: Boomed so loudly at night that the fishing boats turned round and headed for shore.
lore.legendary: Has never been seen by a single birdwatcher, only heard. They now call it the marsh's best-kept secret.

lore.common: Hides in the trees whenever anyone looks, then complains nobody notices it.
lore.uncommon: Builds its nest in the quietest corner of the forest and leaves a sign saying "Private".
lore.rare: Wades through streams so quietly that the fish think it's a branch.
lore.epic: Flew across two continents without anybody spotting it, then sat on a chimney to be seen.
lore.legendary: Delivered a new baby to every family in the village, according to the old story. It's been very tired since.

lore.common: Takes a long run-up before it can take off, then lands a few metres later.
lore.uncommon: Puffs itself up into a ball of white feathers to impress anyone nearby.
lore.rare: Is one of the heaviest flying birds, and makes sure the ground knows when it lands.
lore.epic: Puffed its feathers so wide at the display that it blocked out the sun for the whole plain.
lore.legendary: Flew a whole kilometre without stopping to rest, which it considers the greatest achievement in history.

names.legendary: Dowager Dowitch, Queen of the Mud

lore.common: Pokes its long beak into the mud so fast that it looks like a sewing machine.
lore.uncommon: Runs along the shoreline just ahead of every wave, never quite getting wet.
lore.rare: Probes the mud so quickly that it eats breakfast, lunch and dinner before the tide turns.
lore.epic: Probed so many holes in a mudflat that it looked like a giant pin cushion from the air.
lore.legendary: Stitched the entire beach together with its beak in one afternoon. The sand now stays put.

names.legendary: Sir Quacksworth, Admiral of the Pond

lore.common: Quacks loudly at anyone carrying bread, and gets very cross if it's toast.
lore.uncommon: Waddles across the road with its ducklings in a perfect line and stops all the traffic.
lore.rare: Water slides right off its back, so it splashes everyone else and stays dry.
lore.epic: Led a parade of a hundred ducks through the high street. The shops gave out free bread.
lore.legendary: Became admiral of every pond in the land and inspects each one with a very serious quack.

names.legendary: Gallinula, Queen of the Lily Pads

lore.common: Struts across the lily pads with its long toes and pretends it can walk on water.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its tail with every step like it's always slightly annoyed.
lore.rare: Its bright purple feathers shine so much that the dragonflies keep landing on it.
lore.epic: Led a parade of gallinules across every lily pad in the lake without a single wet foot.
lore.legendary: Walked the entire length of the river on lily pads alone, then claimed it had invented a new sport.

lore.common: Walks with a funny limp and insists it's just its style.
lore.uncommon: Wails so loudly at night that people think there's a ghost in the swamp.
lore.rare: Pulls snails out of their shells so neatly that the snails don't notice until it's too late.
lore.epic: Wailed across the swamp all night and the frogs went on strike for some peace and quiet.
lore.legendary: Ate every snail in the swamp in one season, and the lily pads threw it a thank-you party.

lore.common: Stands so still in the shallows that it once fell asleep standing up.
lore.uncommon: Starts life completely white and slowly turns blue, which it says took a lot of effort.
lore.rare: Can stab a fish with its beak before the fish has finished deciding to swim away.
lore.epic: Stalked through the marsh so patiently that every fish went to sleep waiting for it to strike.
lore.legendary: Caught a fish at every pond in the county in a single day, then had a long, slow, very blue nap.

lore.common: Shouts "peep peep peep" at anything that moves on the beach, including waves.
lore.uncommon: Opens mussels with its bright orange beak like it's using a little screwdriver.
lore.rare: Pipes so loudly in a group that the whole beach thinks a fire alarm has gone off.
lore.epic: Opened every mussel on the rocks in one tide. The beachcombers found nothing but empty shells.
lore.legendary: Ran the busiest shellfish stall on the coast with nothing but its beak, and never once cracked a shell wrong.

names.legendary: Sandy Redback, Dancer of the Tide

lore.common: Runs away from every wave, then runs back after it, then away again, all day.
lore.uncommon: Changes its feathers to red in summer and looks very pleased with itself.
lore.rare: Swirls with its flock so tightly that it looks like one big bird made of smaller birds.
lore.epic: Swirled over the beach with ten thousand friends and the sunbathers thought a cloud had landed.
lore.legendary: Flew halfway around the world without stopping, then landed on the same beach as last year and asked where its towel was.

lore.common: Screams the alarm at everything, including a leaf falling in the wind.
lore.uncommon: Has bright red legs and pretends not to notice when people point at them.
lore.rare: Warns every bird on the marsh about danger so fast that the danger gives up.
lore.epic: Raised such a loud alarm on the marsh that every bird took off at once and left the hunter alone with a sandwich.
lore.legendary: Has warned the marsh about danger for so many seasons that the other birds now call it the warden.

lore.common: Turns over every stone on the beach looking for snacks, then puts none of them back.
lore.uncommon: Flips seaweed, shells and the odd lost flip-flop to see what's underneath.
lore.rare: Turned over a rock so big that it surprised the crab, the fisherman and itself.
lore.epic: Turned over every stone on the beach in one morning. The beach looked completely different by lunch.
lore.legendary: Turned over every pebble on the entire coastline and found two lost rings, a wallet and a pirate's spoon.

names.legendary: Lady Spoonbella of the Pink Lagoon

lore.common: Sweeps its spoon-shaped beak through the water and then complains there's no soup.
lore.uncommon: Swings its head side to side in the water like it's stirring a giant pot.
lore.rare: Stirred up the pond so much that the fish came out dizzy.
lore.epic: Stirred the whole lagoon with its beak until it became one giant pink smoothie.
lore.legendary: Was hired by the finest restaurant in the land to stir its soup. Nobody else has been allowed near the pot since.

lore.common: Builds its nest on the chimney and then complains about the smoke.
lore.uncommon: Clatters its beak like castanets to say hello, which wakes the whole village.
lore.rare: Its nest is so big that the village now uses it as a weather vane.
lore.epic: Built nests on every roof in the village. The village is now officially a bird sanctuary.
lore.legendary: Brought good news to every house in the village, according to the old stories, and still does the rounds every spring.

lore.common: Stares at divers with its pointy teeth and refuses to blink first.
lore.uncommon: Shoots through the water like an arrow and arrives before it has even decided where to go.
lore.rare: Can snap up a fish so fast that the other fish think it vanished by magic.
lore.epic: Raced through the whole reef so fast that every fish got whiplash.
lore.legendary: Became the fastest fish on the reef and won every race, even the ones it wasn't entered in.

lore.common: Swims upstream every year and complains the river is flowing the wrong way.
lore.uncommon: Leaps up waterfalls like they are small steps.
lore.rare: Jumped over a bear waiting at the waterfall and landed on the other side, laughing.
lore.epic: Led a run of a thousand salmon up the river so fast that the bears gave up and went fishing elsewhere.
lore.legendary: Swam all the way from the sea to the mountain lake where it was born, then demanded a medal and a nap.

lore.common: Gives a tiny zap to anyone who steps on it, then pretends nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Can light up a small torch just by sitting near it.
lore.rare: Zapped a diver's camera so the photos all came out fizzy.
lore.epic: Hid under the sand at a swimming beach and gave everyone a mild tickle. The beach shut for the day.
lore.legendary: Powered an entire underwater research station for a month without being asked. The scientists sent a thank-you card.

lore.common: Swims round its bowl all day and acts surprised to see the same plastic castle every time.
lore.uncommon: Blows bubbles at the glass whenever someone walks past, to say hello or to complain.
lore.rare: Ate its food so fast that it spun round the bowl ten times and needed a lie down.
lore.epic: Swam out of its bowl into the bath, out of the bath into the drain, and ended up in the sea having a holiday.
lore.legendary: Was the proud owner of the biggest fishbowl in the land, a castle, a treasure chest and a tiny diving pirate.

lore.common: Floats like a stick in the swamp and enjoys scaring the fishermen.
lore.uncommon: Its scales are so tough that it can bump into rocks without noticing.
lore.rare: Snapped up a fish so fast with its long jaws that the fish doesn't remember being caught.
lore.epic: Shot through the swamp like a torpedo and every frog jumped out of the water.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same swamp since before the dinosaurs, according to the fish, and still refuses to tidy up.

lore.common: Checks its reflection in every diver's mask and pretends it's looking at the diver.
lore.uncommon: Its yellow and black colours are so bright that the coral gets jealous.
lore.rare: Posed for underwater photographers so often that it now charges by the photo.
lore.epic: Held a coral fashion show and every fish on the reef came to watch.
lore.legendary: Became the most photographed fish in the ocean and now has its own reef with a velvet rope around it.

names.legendary: Sturgeonius, the Oldest of the River

lore.common: Sifts through the mud at the bottom of the river and complains that everything tastes of mud.
lore.uncommon: Has armour plates instead of scales and walks along the riverbed like a tank.
lore.rare: Jumped out of the river so high that a passing boat had to duck.
lore.epic: Swam through the river so slowly and powerfully that the river had to wait for it to pass.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same river for over a hundred years and knows the names of every fish that ever swam in it.

lore.common: Waves its tentacles at every passing fish, then gets cross when they don't wave back.
lore.uncommon: Lets the clownfish live in its tentacles and charges rent in crumbs.
lore.rare: Stings any fish that's rude to its clownfish lodger.
lore.epic: Grew so many friends in one rockpool that it became the most popular garden on the beach.
lore.legendary: Ran the busiest hotel on the reef, with a hundred clownfish guests, and never had a single bad review.

lore.common: Looks like a giant brain, so the fish ask it for help with their homework.
lore.uncommon: Grows so slowly that it's still thinking about what happened last year.
lore.rare: Solved every puzzle the reef had in one tide, mostly by staying very still.
lore.epic: Grew so big that it became a reef all by itself and the fish moved in.
lore.legendary: Has been thinking about one question for a thousand years. The fish are still waiting politely for the answer.

names.legendary: Medusa Moonglow, Queen of the Drift

lore.common: Floats around with no idea where it's going and is still always late.
lore.uncommon: Glows softly in the dark sea like a forgotten lamp.
lore.rare: Its long tentacles drift for metres behind it, stinging anything that bumps into them.
lore.epic: Gathered thousands of jellyfish into a swarm that turned the whole bay into a glowing lantern show.
lore.legendary: Drifted across every ocean in the world without ever deciding to go anywhere. Still asks for directions.

lore.common: Squirts ink whenever it's surprised, so every photo of it is just black.
lore.uncommon: Can open a jar from the inside, then complains that the jar was empty.
lore.rare: Changes colour to match whatever it's sitting on, including a chessboard.
lore.epic: Escaped from the aquarium tank every night to visit the other tanks, then went back before morning.
lore.legendary: Mastered eight different hobbies at once, one for each arm, and became the most talented creature in the sea.

lore.common: Hoots outside your window every night at exactly the wrong time.
lore.uncommon: Turns its head almost all the way round to see who's behind it, then turns it back looking smug.
lore.rare: Flies so silently that it lands on the gatepost and nobody notices for an hour.
lore.epic: Hooted from every tree in the forest at midnight and kept the whole woodland awake.
lore.legendary: Knew the answer to every question in the forest and opened a night school. All the lessons start at midnight.

lore.common: Waddles everywhere so slowly that it slides on its belly when it's in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Huddles in the middle of the group in winter and never takes a turn on the outside.
lore.rare: Swims so fast underwater that it shoots out onto the ice like a cork.
lore.epic: Led ten thousand penguins down an icy hill on their bellies. The polar scientists joined in.
lore.legendary: Waddled all the way across the South Pole to deliver a single pebble to its best friend.

lore.common: Clicks and whistles loudly at the boat and won't stop until someone waves.
lore.uncommon: Leaps out of the water in perfect arcs whenever it notices people watching.
lore.rare: Raced alongside a ferry and won, then did a backflip to celebrate.
lore.epic: Performed so many tricks in the bay that every tourist boat stopped to watch. The ferry was late all day.
lore.legendary: Guided a lost ship safely through a foggy channel by leaping in front of it. The captain named the ship after it.

names.legendary: Grey Gertrude, Wanderer of the Pacific

lore.common: Rubs barnacles off its back on the seabed and then sulks that they come back.
lore.uncommon: Spouts water from its blowhole right when the tourists lean over to take a photo.
lore.rare: Scoops up mud from the seabed with its mouth and sifts out tiny shrimp like a giant sieve.
lore.epic: Swam so close to a whale-watching boat that everyone on board got splashed.
lore.legendary: Swam from the icy north to the warm south and back again every year for a century, and still remembers where it left its favourite lagoon.

lore.common: Circles the boat for an hour and then swims off because it was only curious.
lore.uncommon: Grows new teeth whenever it loses one, so it always has a brand new smile.
lore.rare: Can smell a single drop of tuna in a swimming pool from the far end.
lore.epic: Patrolled the reef so thoroughly that every fish now swims in neat lines.
lore.legendary: Swam the oceans for centuries without ever needing to visit a dentist.

lore.common: Spouts water from its blowhole right when someone has just dried their hair.
lore.uncommon: Sings long songs that travel across the whole ocean, then complains that nobody sings back.
lore.rare: Breached out of the water so high that a seagull landed on its nose.
lore.epic: Did a belly flop in the bay and the wave washed every beach towel up onto the promenade.
lore.legendary: Sang a song so beautiful that every whale in every ocean learned the words. It is still the ocean's favourite lullaby.

lore.common: Bobs up and down in the water and pretends it's doing it on purpose.
lore.uncommon: Floats up and down by changing the air inside its spiral shell, like a tiny submarine.
lore.rare: Rose from the deep sea at night so suddenly that the fishing boat thought it had caught a submarine.
lore.epic: Spun through the deep sea so fast in its spiral shell that it left a whirlpool behind.
lore.legendary: Has been swimming in the same shape for millions of years and says the design is perfect, thank you.

lore.common: Clings to the rock so tightly that the tide gives up trying to move it.
lore.uncommon: Can grow a new arm if it loses one, and boasts about it to the crabs.
lore.rare: Opened a mussel with its arms in one slow, very determined afternoon.
lore.epic: Led a dance of starfish across the rockpools at low tide, spinning like slow wheels.
lore.legendary: Lit up the night sea so beautifully that sailors used it to find their way home.

lore.common: Grows a tiny bit every year and expects everyone to notice.
lore.uncommon: Builds homes for every fish on the reef and charges no rent at all.
lore.rare: Grows so thickly that fish get lost in it and have to ask for directions.
lore.epic: Built a reef so big that it can be seen from the boats as a rainbow under the water.
lore.legendary: Built the greatest reef in the ocean, a city for a million fish, one tiny piece at a time.

lore.common: Takes so long to swim across the bay that the fish set up a café on its shell.
lore.uncommon: Swims back to the beach where it hatched, every few years, and still remembers the way.
lore.rare: Flapped its flippers once and glided further than the speedboat.
lore.epic: Hatched with a thousand brothers and sisters who all ran into the sea at the same moment. The beach looked like it was moving.
lore.legendary: Swam around every ocean in the world over a long, slow lifetime, and the fish in each one still remember its name.
